title: 美妆黑马季度涨36%：全年目标上调至20%，底气从哪来
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's first start off with the numbers and more importantly, the forecast.
segments.zh: 我们先从数字说起，更重要的是，预测。

segments.en: I mean, you raised that full year guidance up to about 18 to 20 percent up from 12 to 14 percent.
segments.zh: 你把全年指引上调至约18%到20%，之前是12%到14%。

segments.en: You're only just one quarter into the fiscal year. You must have some pretty good confidence here about what the next three quarters look like.
segments.zh: 财年才过了一个季度，你对未来三个季度肯定很有信心。

segments.en: Why be so aggressive? Well, first of all, thank you for having me.
segments.zh: 为什么这么激进？首先，感谢邀请。

segments.en: It's great to be on again. I'm just so proud of our LF Beauty team.
segments.zh: 很高兴再次参加。我为我们的LF Beauty团队感到骄傲。

segments.en: We just delivered 36 percent net sales growth in our first quarter.
segments.zh: 第一季度净销售额增长了36%。

segments.en: And as you said, we've tremendous confidence in the business. Give them momentum.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，我们对业务充满信心，势头很好。

segments.en: We're seeing we did raise our outlook to 18 to 20 percent growth this year.
segments.zh: 我们确实将今年的增长预期上调至18%到20%。

segments.en: And it's really under the confidence behind every one of our brands and our portfolio.
segments.zh: 这源于我们对每个品牌和产品组合的信心。

segments.en: And we see growth in all of them and we're in a great position. Well, let's talk about road.
segments.zh: 我们看到所有品牌都在增长，我们处于有利地位。

segments.en: It's obviously doing a lot of heavy lifting here over a half a billion dollars in sales up something like 80 percent.
segments.zh: 显然，这贡献巨大，销售额超过5亿美元，增长约80%。

segments.en: And if you go through Sephora as sort of rankings of beauty products, I believe it is still ranking up there as number one.
segments.zh: 如果你看丝芙兰的美妆产品排名，我相信它仍然位列第一。

segments.en: Is this your growth engine now road? Well, you know, the great thing about LF Beauty is all of our brands, our growth engine.
segments.zh: 这是你的增长引擎吗？LF Beauty的妙处在于，我们所有品牌都是增长引擎。

segments.en: Our last five year cager from a net sales standpoint is about 40 percent.
segments.zh: 过去五年，我们的净销售额复合年增长率约为40%。

segments.en: We've now delivered 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth, averaging at least 20 percent growth per quarter.
segments.zh: 我们已经连续30个季度实现净销售额增长，平均每季度增长至少20%。

segments.en: So we had a long track record of consistent industry leading growth.
segments.zh: 因此，我们拥有长期一致的行业领先增长记录。

segments.en: Certainly road is an incredibly special brand has incredible sales.
segments.zh: 当然，road是一个非常特别的品牌，拥有惊人的销售额。

segments.en: Number one brand, it's a four and mecca. And as great as the results have been, we're really excited.
segments.zh: 它是第一品牌，在丝芙兰和Mecca都是如此。尽管成绩斐然，我们仍非常兴奋。
